item.title: How to collect labels and annotations of Kubernetes objects
item.description: 1. Why kube-status-metrics is needed Kubernetes monitoring mainly focuses on two kinds of metrics: Basic performance metrics CPU, memory, disk, network, and so on. These can be collected by deploying node-exporter as a DaemonSet and having Prometheus scrape the relevant metrics. Resource object metrics The replica count of a Deployment, the running state of a Pod, and so on.
